AccordionContext.description: Provide this above a grid to make its tiles collapsible on a phone.

ActionRow.description:
One step in a list of things to do: a verb ("Turn on") followed by the controls that finish it (a device picker, a
number), with a remove button at the end. Used by the automation, scene and routine builders.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: verb
props.description: What the step does: "Turn on", "Dim".

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button when given.

AddTile.description: Dashed "add" tile that sits at the end of a device grid.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the tile is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: hint
props.description: A small line under the label.

Avatar.description: Round initial. `tone` 1 to 4 picks the colour; `away` greys it.

props.name: initial
props.description: One letter.

props.name: tone
props.description: 1 to 4.

props.name: away
props.description: Greys it: the person is away.

Bar.description: Horizontal meter: a `Progress` that takes a percentage. `warn` turns it clay.

props.name: percent
props.description: How full the bar is, 0 to 100.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: label
props.description: What is progressing, for screen readers.

props.name: warn
props.description: Turns the fill clay: close to a limit.

BottomSheet.description:
Bottom sheet. Drag it down to dismiss: it follows the finger, and a flick closes it faster.
Put `data-base-ui-swipe-ignore` on any child that needs its own drag (the Slider already does).

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the person dismisses it (Escape, a tap outside, a swipe down).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is showing.

Button.description: Pill-shaped action button. Icons and text go in as children. Ref and native props pass through.

props.name: haptic
props.description: A haptic on press. Off by default: a plain tap needs none. Use `medium` for the one action that sends something out, `warning` for a danger button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, keeps the width, and ignores taps until it clears.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is 42 px tall; `lg` is 52 px (thumb-sized, for the main action on a phone); `sm` is for dense rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: `primary` is the one main action on a surface (dark); `sage` confirms calmly; `danger` is for things that cannot be undone; `ghost` is borderless; the default is a quiet fill.

buttonVariants.description: Class recipe for anything that should look like a button (links, triggers).

Checkbox.description: Tick box. With children it renders a tappable row, so the whole label toggles it.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it is on (controlled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass `label` for screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the control off.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows a dash instead of a tick: some, but not all, of what it covers is selected.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers.

Chip.description: Status chip for the hero. A button when given `onClick`, otherwise inert text that is skipped by Tab.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: warn
props.description: Outlines the chip: something to look at.

cn.description: Join class names. Falsy values are skipped; arrays and `{ name: condition }` objects are flattened.

ColorWheel.description:
Colour wheel: angle is hue, distance from the centre is saturation. Previews while dragging, commits on release. It ticks each
30 degrees of hue, clicks at the centre (white) and bumps at the rim. Double-tap to go straight to white.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the wheel for screen readers: "Lamp colour".

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the chosen colour when the finger lifts (not on every move).

props.name: rgb
props.description: The current colour as `[red, green, blue]`, each 0 to 255.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it needs a passkey, in a line or two.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called by the Cancel button, Escape, or a tap outside.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the confirm button is pressed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is showing.

props.name: state
props.description: `idle` waits for a tap; `go` shows that the passkey prompt is open; `ok` shows it worked.

props.name: title
props.description: What is being confirmed, as a short sentence.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The cancel button's text. Keep it "Cancel": it is the word people look for.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirm button's text.

props.name: confirmRef
props.description: A ref to the confirm button, so it can take focus when the dialog opens.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Styles the confirm button as dangerous (red). Only for things that cannot be undone, and that the person did not choose with that in mind.

CoverShade.description:
A window with a shade you pull: drag down to close, up to open. Previews live, commits on release. It clicks at each quarter,
and if you pull past either end it stretches with growing resistance and bumps, then settles back. A flick carries on.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers.

props.name: moving
props.description: Pulses the handle while the cover is moving.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the chosen position when the finger lifts.

props.name: pos
props.description: How open the cover is: 0 closed, 100 open.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

DeviceTile.description:
Phone device tile. Tap to toggle. Drag sideways to set its main value: it ticks at each quarter, bumps at either end, stretches
if you pull past an end, and a flick carries on after you let go. Hold for more controls (or press the chevron): a slight press-in
shows the hold is coming, and a firm tap confirms it was recognised.

props.name: detail
props.description: State line under the name, for example "60% · Living room".

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: name
props.description: The device's name.

props.name: onTap
props.description: Tap: usually toggles the device.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: dragValue
props.description: Current level 0–100 for drag-to-set. A sideways drag on the tile sets it; the tile fills live and `onDragCommit` fires on release.

props.name: fill
props.description: 0–100. Draws a level fill from the bottom, like a dimmer.

props.name: hint
props.description: What the gestures do, read after the name: "Tap to toggle. Hold for more."

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the accessible name. Leave it out: then the visible name and state are the name, as "label in name" (WCAG 2.5.3) asks.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Screen-reader name for the chevron. Defaults to "More controls for <name>".

props.name: on
props.description: Whether the device is on: the tile glows.

props.name: onDragCommit
props.description: Called with the chosen level (0 to 100, in steps of 5) when a sideways drag ends. 0 means off.

props.name: onHold
props.description: Fires after a half-second press. A tap that follows a hold is swallowed.

props.name: onMore
props.description: Shows the chevron that opens the full controls (the tap-free twin of holding).

props.name: spin
props.description: Seconds per turn: the icon spins (a fan).

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour the "on" glow (a lamp's own colour).

props.name: warn
props.description: Needs attention (an unlocked door, for example).

Dial.description: Radial dial: drag around a 270° arc. Previews while dragging, commits on release.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the dial for screen readers: "Target temperature".

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the chosen value when the finger lifts.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: children
props.description: Show live while dragging (for the centre text).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the filled arc.

props.name: marker
props.description: A second marker on the track (the room's current temperature).

props.name: resetValue
props.description: Double-tap the dial to return to this value (a default). Leave it out for no reset.

props.name: step
props.description: Size of one step: the dial snaps to multiples of it.

props.name: unit
props.description: Shown after the value for screen readers ("24 degrees"), for example "°".

Empty.description: What to show when there is nothing yet. It is temporary: say what to do next, and give the action if there is one.

props.name: action
props.description: The next step, usually a Button: an empty state is a signpost, not a dead end.

Eyebrow.description: Small uppercase mono label that sits above a title.

Field.description: A label and its control, on one line (wrapping when narrow). The label is the control's accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers.

props.name: minLabel
props.description: Minimum width of the label in px, to line several fields up.

FieldRow.description: Wrapper for several fields that sit on one row.

FilterChip.description: Filter chip with an optional count, used for room filters. `pressed` is the selected state.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether it is selected.

props.name: count
props.description: A number shown after the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

haptic.description: Plays one haptic. Does nothing when the person turned haptics off, when the device cannot, or when it is too soon after the last one.

hapticsSupported.description: True where a haptic can be felt at all: Android Chrome's vibrate, or the iPhone path.

Html.description: Trusted in-app HTML (activity strings that carry bold). Never pass user input: it is not sanitised.

props.name: html
props.description: Markup from the app itself. Never user input: it is not sanitised.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render.

Icon.description: One 24 px icon set, 1.7 stroke, round caps. Decorative by default: pair it with text, or pass `title`.

props.name: n
props.description: The icon's name. Any string is accepted (so a name can come from data) and unknown names draw nothing.

props.name: c
props.description: Extra size or motion classes: `sm`, `lg`, `spin`.

props.name: filled
props.description: Draws the solid form where there is one (the selected tab); otherwise the outline.

props.name: title
props.description: Gives the icon a name for screen readers. Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from them.

IconButton.description: Square, icon-only button. It has no visible text, so it must carry an accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the button for screen readers. Required: there is no text to read.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks it as the current choice (a pressed look).

props.name: haptic
props.description: A haptic on press. Off by default.

IconTile.description: Square icon holder used at the start of rows.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

Input.description: Text input. Size classes: `inp--sm`, `inp--code`, `inp--fill`, `inp--mono`. Always give it a label (a `Field` around it, or `aria-label`).

props.name: rows
props.description: `[key, value]` pairs, in order.

Loading.description: Calm waiting state: a softly breathing mark and a short line. Use instead of bare "Loading…" text.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being waited for, in a few words.

LockTile.description: Door tile for a dark surface. Amber when the door is open.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: locked
props.description: Whether the door is locked. Unlocked shows amber.

props.name: name
props.description: The door's name.

props.name: status
props.description: What state it is in, in words: "Locked", "Open · tap to lock".

props.name: hint
props.description: What a tap does, read after the name and state (hidden from sight): "Tap to unlock."

Modal.description:
Centred or top-anchored dialog. Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close;
Escape and a tap on the scrim dismiss it. It animates out as well as in.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the person dismisses it (Escape, a tap outside, a swipe down).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is showing.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element to focus when it opens. Defaults to the first focusable one.

props.name: placement
props.description: `top` sits near the top (good with a keyboard); `center` is for short confirmations.

ModeButton.description: One option in a household-mode picker. `pressed` marks the active mode.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: label
props.description: The mode's name.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether it is selected.

props.name: description
props.description: A short line under the label.

Notice.description: An inline message that stays on the page: something to know (info), something done (ok), or something to fix (warn, announced to screen readers).

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: action
props.description: An optional button at the end.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the icon the tone would pick.

props.name: tone
props.description: `warn` is something to fix (announced at once); `ok` confirms; `info` is for your information.

Nudge.description:
Visible minus and plus beside a control you set by dragging. A gesture is never the only way to do something (Apple's
rule for custom gestures), and a drag is hard for some people: this is the twin that is always on screen.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being changed, for the button names: "Floor lamp brightness" gives "Lower Floor lamp brightness".

props.name: onMinus
props.description: Called by the minus button.

props.name: onPlus
props.description: Called by the plus button.

props.name: children
props.description: A short line between the buttons. Hidden at large text sizes, where there is no room for it.

props.name: minusDisabled
props.description: Greys the minus button (at the lowest value).

props.name: plusDisabled
props.description: Greys the plus button (at the highest value).

OptionButton.description: One toggleable card in an `OptionGroup`. `pressed` is the selected state.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading element, usually an `Icon`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether it is selected.

OptionGroup.description: Wrap-around group of option cards: several can be on at once (use `Segmented` for exactly one).

PageHeader.description: Page title block: the page's one `h1`, with an optional line under it.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title (the one `h1`).

Pill.description: Small status label with an optional leading icon. Colour is never the only signal: say the status in words too.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon name.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the colour: ok (done, safe), warn (needs a look), info (for your information).

Popover.description: Small floating panel anchored to its trigger. Focus moves in on open and back out on close.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it.

props.name: align
props.description: How it lines up with the trigger along that side.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading inside the panel. Also names it for screen readers.

PopoverClose.description: Put on any control inside a Popover that should close it.

Progress.description: Determinate progress bar. The fill glides to a new value. Exposes `role="progressbar"` to assistive tech.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: label
props.description: What is progressing, for screen readers.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value.

props.name: warn
props.description: Turns the fill clay: close to a limit.

project.description:
Where something flicked from `pos` (0 to 1) with velocity `vel` (fractions per second) comes to rest. A flick carries on after the
finger lifts, the way a scroll view does: the distance is the sum of a decelerating glide. `rate` is how quickly it slows
(0.998 glides a long way, 0.99 a short one). The result is not clamped.

Safe.description: Checklist-style list of reassurances. `muted` rows use a cross.

props.name: items
props.type: (string | { text: string; muted?: boolean; icon?: string; })[]
props.description: Each line, as plain text or `{ text, muted, icon }`. `muted` shows a cross: something Alice does not do.

SceneCard.description: Scene or routine card. `suggested` outlines it in sage.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon from the icon set.

props.name: name
props.description: The scene's name.

props.name: description
props.description: What it does, in a short line.

props.name: suggested
props.description: Outlines the card: Alice suggests it for now.

props.name: tag
props.description: A small label at the bottom: "Routine", "Suggested".

Segmented.description:
Single-choice control. A thumb slides between segments on a spring, arrow keys move the choice
(roving tabindex, like a native radio group), and it behaves as a radiogroup for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.description: `[value, label]` pairs, in order.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for screen readers.

Select.description:
Drop-down list. A real popup instead of the browser's native one, so it matches the rest of the UI,
opens and closes with a spring, and supports type-ahead and arrow keys. Touch opens it below the field.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: options
props.description: `[value, label]` pairs.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the control off.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label next to it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while nothing is chosen.

setHapticsEnabled.description: Turns haptics on or off for this device, and remembers it.

Slider.description:
Filled slider built from real elements, so the fill glides when a value jumps (a preset tap)
and the thumb lifts while it is dragged. It opts out of the bottom sheet's swipe-to-dismiss.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the control off.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value.

props.name: resetValue
props.description: Double-tap the bar to return to this value (a default, such as full brightness). Leave it out for no reset.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value beside the bar as live feedback while it is dragged.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is the thin bar; `xl` is the tall full-width bar for sheets.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Words for a value, for screen readers and for `showValue`: `(v) => `${v}%``. Defaults to the bare number.

Sparkline.description: Smooth area sparkline with an end-point dot. Draws in the sage colour; the label is what a screen reader says.

props.name: values
props.description: The series, oldest first. Needs at least two values.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the drawing area in its own units.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the drawing area in its own units; the SVG scales to its container.

StepButton.description: Round stepper button (plus or minus). Like `IconButton`, it needs an accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the button for screen readers: "More backups".

props.name: haptic
props.description: A haptic on press. Off by default: a `Stepper` ticks for itself.

Stepper.description:
A number you nudge up and down with round buttons, held between `min` and `max`. Tap for one step. Press and hold to run through a
range: it starts steady and speeds up the longer you hold. Or drag the number itself sideways, one step every few pixels, like
scrubbing. Each step ticks, and reaching either end bumps. Arrow keys work too. For small counts, not free typing.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control for screen readers, e.g. "Backups to keep".

props.name: max
props.description: Largest value.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: step
props.description: Size of one step.

props.name: unit
props.description: Shown after the number, e.g. "backups" or "h".

Steps.description: Step list for multi-stage jobs. `current` is the active step index.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the step in progress: earlier ones are done, later ones wait.

props.name: steps
props.description: The names of the steps, in order.

Switch.description:
On/off switch. Tap it, or drag the thumb across and let go: it lands on whichever side it is nearer to, with a bump as it
crosses the middle. The thumb stretches while pressed and settles with a light spring; on and off feel different.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it is on (controlled).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Required because the switch has no visible text.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the control off.

Table.description: A simple table that scrolls sideways on a narrow screen. `mono` sets it in the code font.

props.name: head
props.description: Column headings.

props.name: rows
props.description: One array of cells per row.

props.name: mono
props.description: Sets the table in the code font, smaller.

Tabs.description: Pill tab bar. A dark thumb slides to the chosen tab, and the bar scrolls sideways when it does not fit.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tab list for screen readers.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { id: T; label: string; badge?: boolean; }[]
props.description: `badge` shows a small dot: something in that tab needs a look.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

Textarea.description: Multi-line text input. Same size classes as `Input`.

Tile.description: A card on the home grid: sized in columns and rows, tinted with `tone`, and (on a phone, inside an `AccordionContext`) collapsible.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable name for the tile: becomes its element id and its accordion key.

props.name: bare
props.description: Skip the card chrome. Used for phone layouts that style themselves.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: cols
props.description: Column span on desktop.

props.name: colsMobile
props.description: Column span on a phone.

props.name: colsTablet
props.description: Column span on a tablet.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start expanded when inside an accordion.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row span.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles, including `--custom` properties.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour treatment: sage, clay, glow, deep, or hero.

TileHeader.description: Tile header: title, optional eyebrow above it, optional trailing control.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label above the title.

props.name: right
props.description: A control at the end of the header.

props.name: title
props.description: The tile's heading.

TimeField.description: A time of day. Uses the device's own time picker, so it is native on phones.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the field for screen readers, e.g. "Backup time".

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

props.name: value
props.description: 24-hour "HH:MM".

Toast.description:
A short notice that appears at the bottom of the screen. It is a card, not a pill: long messages wrap (and, past five
lines, are cut with a tap to read the rest). It pauses while it is being pointed at or touched, so it cannot vanish
mid-sentence, and warnings are announced to screen readers straight away.

props.name: message
props.description: What happened, in plain words.

props.name: show
props.description: Whether it is on screen.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names, merged with the component's own.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long it stays, in ms: by default it grows with the message (3.2 s to 10 s). `null` keeps it until dismissed, which is the default for `warn` (a failure is never taken away before it is read).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the time is up or the close button is pressed.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Shows an Undo button; the toast stays a little longer.

props.name: placement
props.description: `fixed` sits at the bottom of the screen above the phone's tab bar; `inline` flows with the page (for the library page).

props.name: title
props.description: A short bold line above the message, for longer notices.

props.name: tone
props.description: `warn` is announced to screen readers at once and shows an alert icon.

toastDuration.description: How long to leave a message up: enough to read it, never less than 3.2 s, never more than 10 s.

Tooltip.description: Short label for an icon button. Shows on hover and keyboard focus; never on touch.

props.name: children
props.description: The one element that triggers it (usually an icon button). It must carry its own accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: The tip. Keep it to a few words.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

TooltipProvider.description: Wrap a region once so neighbouring tooltips open instantly after the first one.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

useDoubleTap.description:
Calls `onDouble` when the element is tapped twice quickly in the same place. A press that moved (a drag) is not a tap, so
dragging a control and then letting go never counts. Spread the result onto the element.

useDrag.description:
Pointer-capture drag over an element. `move` gets the pointer as 0 to 1 fractions of the element's box (clamped), and as a fourth
argument the same position unclamped (so a control can stretch when pulled past its end);
`end` fires on release with the last position and the velocity at the moment of release (use it with `project`
to let a flick carry on). Props go on the element itself.

useHapticsEnabled.description: The setting, for a switch: `[enabled, setEnabled]`.

useSwipeSelect.description:
Lets a row of choices be swiped: put a finger on one and slide, and the choice under it is selected as it passes (like
an iOS segmented control). A plain tap still clicks. `itemSelector` finds the items inside the element the props go on.

WhiteStrip.description: Warm-to-cool strip for white light. The track shows the real colour at each end of the lamp's range.

props.name: kelvin
props.description: The current colour temperature in Kelvin.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the strip for screen readers.

props.name: max
props.description: The coolest the lamp can go, in Kelvin (the right end).

props.name: min
props.description: The warmest the lamp can go, in Kelvin (the left end).

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the chosen temperature when the finger lifts.
